gate_reason: Of 101 claims scored, 14 are High confidence (13.9%), 34 are Medium (33.7%), and 53 are Low (52.5%). The 52.5% Low rate places this stage firmly in the ship-with-flag zone (30-70% Low). The Low concentration is driven by three structural factors: (1) 16 ASSUMED-tagged claims that are correctly self-identified by the draft as unverified — these inflate the Low count but are transparently flagged; (2) 9 market-sizing claims using single secondary market research firms (GMI Insights, MarketsandMarkets, Mordor Intelligence) with no cross-validation — all receive mandatory secondary-market-research-only overrides; and (3) 10 single-vendor-source overrides for operating metrics and performance claims. The draft's strongest assets are its primary sources: the Motive S-1 (SEC), Samsara 10-K (SEC), Karooooo 6-K (SEC), WHO Indonesia country profile, FMCSA regulatory pages, and Verisk/CargoNet industry data — all scored High. There is one critical factual error (PP3.2-6): the Nirvana Series D funding claim cites URLs describing an $80M/$830M round, not the $100M/$1.5B stated — this must be corrected before publication. The Indonesia commercial fleet size figures (VC-42 citing 23M+, PP3.3-3 citing 4-5M) are internally inconsistent and both lack proper primary-gov sourcing from BPS Indonesia or Kemenhub. Deep research should prioritize: (a) correcting the Nirvana citation, (b) sourcing nuclear verdict data directly from ILR, (c) replacing the SambaSafety-sourced 70%/79% telematics-sharing statistics with an independent survey, and (d) sourcing Indonesia vehicle registration data from BPS.

Correct Nirvana Series D citation (PP3.2-6) — factual inconsistency between claim and cited source

Source nuclear verdict data from ILR directly rather than Marsh MMA broker commentary
Source SambaSafety 70%/79% telematics sharing statistics from independent survey (ATRI, NPTC, TCA, or Frost & Sullivan)
Source NHTSA commercial truck fatality statistics directly from NHTSA rather than through ABI Research press release (PP3.4-5)
